title: María Zambrano's birth chart
metaDescription: María Zambrano's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 1.9° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 22.8° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 1.9° Taurus, inside the first decan (0°–10°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Venus. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 21.9° Taurus; Venus stands at 11.5° Aries; Mars stands at 11.6° Taurus. The tradition reads thought with its feet on the ground from Mercury, attraction declared rather than implied from Venus, effort banked steadily until it tells from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Saturn to Pluto, a trine with 0.6° of slack. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, Venus conjunction Jupiter at 1.1°, and the Sun sextile Neptune at 1.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. The Moon in Cancer at 22.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Aries at 11.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Taurus at 11.6° is in detriment; Saturn in Aquarius at 19.8° is in domicile. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 3 in earth, 3 in fire, 2 in water, 2 in air by element, 4 fixed, 4 cardinal, 2 mutable by modality. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. Uranus was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.9° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 22.8°.
